mapper.update: update orders set status = ${@com.dingdingcatering.entity.Orders@CANCELLED}, cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, cancel_time = now() where id = #{id}
update orders set status = ${@com.dingdingcatering.entity.Orders@COMPLETED}, delivery_time = now() where id = #{id}

update orders set status = ${@com.dingdingcatering.entity.Orders@CANCELLED}, rejection_reason = #{rejectionReason}, cancel_time = now(), pay_status = if(pay_status = ${@com.dingdingcatering.entity.Orders@PAID}, ${@com.dingdingcatering.entity.Orders@REFUND}, pay_status) where id = #{id}
update orders set status = ${@com.dingdingcatering.entity.Orders@CONFIRMED}, estimated_delivery_time = NOW() + INTERVAL 30 MINUTE where id = #{id}
update orders set status = ${@com.dingdingcatering.entity.Orders@DELIVERY_IN_PROGRESS}, delivery_time = now() + INTERVAL 15 MINUTE where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select o.id, o.number, o.status, o.user_id, o.address_book_id, o.order_time, o.checkout_time, o.pay_method, o.pay_status, o.amount, o.remark, o.consignee, o.phone, o.address, o.cancel_reason, o.rejection_reason, o.cancel_time, o.estimated_delivery_time, o.delivery_status, o.delivery_time, o.pack_amount, o.tableware_number, o.tableware_status, u.name as user_name from orders o left join `user` u on u.id = o.user_id where o.id = #{id}

select o.id, o.number, o.status, o.user_id, o.address_book_id, o.order_time, o.checkout_time, o.pay_method, o.pay_status, o.amount, o.remark, o.consignee, o.phone, o.address, o.cancel_reason, o.rejection_reason, o.cancel_time, o.estimated_delivery_time, o.delivery_status, o.delivery_time, o.pack_amount, o.tableware_number, o.tableware_status, u.name as user_name from orders o left join `user` u on u.id = o.user_id where o.number = #{number}

select sum(status = ${@com.dingdingcatering.entity.Orders@TO_BE_CONFIRMED}) as toBeConfirmed, sum(status = ${@com.dingdingcatering.entity.Orders@CONFIRMED}) as confirmed, sum(status = ${@com.dingdingcatering.entity.Orders@DELIVERY_IN_PROGRESS}) as deliveryInProgress, sum(status = ${@com.dingdingcatering.entity.Orders@COMPLETED}) as completed, sum(status = ${@com.dingdingcatering.entity.Orders@CANCELLED}) as cancelled, sum(status = ${@com.dingdingcatering.entity.Orders@REFUNDED}) as refunded from orders where status in ( ${@com.dingdingcatering.entity.Orders@TO_BE_CONFIRMED}, ${@com.dingdingcatering.entity.Orders@CONFIRMED}, ${@com.dingdingcatering.entity.Orders@DELIVERY_IN_PROGRESS}, ${@com.dingdingcatering.entity.Orders@COMPLETED}, ${@com.dingdingcatering.entity.Orders@CANCELLED}, ${@com.dingdingcatering.entity.Orders@REFUNDED} )
